verdict.rationale: Kick documents an official CLI (kick-docs-28) with a quickstart guide for authenticating, selecting a workspace, and pulling transactions/financial statements from the terminal, and links it alongside MCP as an AI-native access path (kick-docs-15). However, the CLI's documented scope is narrower than the MCP integration (read/report-focused vs. full read-write bookkeeping actions), and there's only a single quickstart doc with no independent/hands-on verification of the CLI itself. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of CLI functioning, fuller CLI command reference/capabilities beyond the quickstart, and parity with MCP's write/automation capabilities.
